core_intent.statement: Use authentic process evidence to build trust

audience.primary: Viewers who care how the result was made

desired_viewer_shift.statement: From seeing a result to understanding why it is credible

creative_center.statement: The authentic process is the protagonist; the product is outcome evidence

must_communicate: A visible change connects process to result
anti_direction: A generic product advertisement without progression
success_tests: All three story structures create the same viewer shift
